method: Every field of every symbol row in symbol_contracts.json compared against the per-symbol lane SPEC dossiers (wave-1/2 committed evidence) and, one level down, against the raw evidence each SPEC cites (spot-verified >=2 raw citations per symbol). Verdicts: MATCH (evidence supports the value), MISMATCH (committed evidence contradicts the value), PENDING (no committed evidence found). NO value in symbol_contracts.json was edited by this lane; MISMATCH/PENDING are findings for the controller. Light reads only; heavy lock not taken.
counting_convention: 12 verification units per symbol: tick_size, tick_value_usd, multiplier, exchange, quote_ccy, base_ccy, long_base_sign, quote_direction_note, session_mask_spec.tz, session_mask_spec.rth, session_mask_spec.note, era_table. era_table is one unit (era-row sub-verdicts inside). Total 6 symbols x 12 = 72 units.
